labels: Original PhysioNet labels, already shifted six hours; no second shift
explanation_sampling: One label-independent hashed-time endpoint per validation patient, then four risk quartiles with low/median/high missingness; unique patients
explanation_agent: Existing frozen Qwen3.8-27B prompts, corpus, BF16 decoding and bounded graph
feature_ablation: Set each feature value and observation-mask channel to zero across its causal window; sensitivity proxy, not causal clinical attribution
expert_annotations: Outcome- and model-identity-blinded reviewer packet; no automated clinician scores
intended_scope: Retrospective benchmark performance and automated explanation-grounding audit; no prospective clinical efficacy claim
lead_time_clock: First positive shifted label; not directly measured clinical onset
grounding_numeric_tolerance: 0.05 absolute or 0.5% of observed value, plus feature alias and explicit patient-context language
confidence_scope: Conditional on the frozen models, calibrators and thresholds; file-level patient clustering assumes published patient IDs are distinct people
